summary: Scalar deleting-destructor dispatch helper (__thiscall): unconditionally runs VTableSetInitCall(), then frees the this object via FreeWrapper_7bcf only when flag a2 bit 0 is set. Returns this. The flag follows the MSVC scalar-deleting-destructor convention where a2 == 0 deletes without freeing and a2 == 1 deletes then frees.

operations.description: Invoke VTableSetInitCall() unconditionally at function entry.
Guard on (a2 & 1) != 0 before the free; when bit 0 of the flag is clear the object is not freed.
Invoke FreeWrapper_7bcf(this) to release the object memory when the guard passes.
